name: voice
description: Local speech. One WAV from text, and a transcript from a session audio file.

tools.name: synthesize
tools.description: Speaks text with the local piper voice and saves a WAV. Use this when the user wants the answer read aloud as a file. An empty text or a missing piper setup returns an error line and no file.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcribes one audio file already stored for this session. Pass the file name from that folder. A missing file or a missing speech model returns an error line.

name.description: File name in the session audio folder

changelog: 1.1.0 - synthesize and transcribe ask the host. The spoken text and the transcript stay out of the bridge row.
